source.title: Open problems arised from a Vrănceanu's topic.

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document identifier 2108311.

Failure mode: metadata_only plus network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetching. The sandboxed shell could not resolve zbmath.org or api.zbmath.org, the page reader did not expose a readable zbMATH record body, and the zbMATH API presented a terms-gated landing page rather than document JSON. Local resolver metadata identified the same source as 'Open problems arised from a Vranceanu's topic.', year 2001.

Bounded recovery used exact-work searches for the title with and without the Vranceanu diacritic, the title plus PDF, the title plus Iordanescu, the journal name plus volume/pages, and Bulletin volume pages for Tome 44(92), No. 1 (2001). Candidate pages were rejected because they were author CV or bibliography metadata, zbMATH serial metadata, journal issue indexes, or search snippets rather than a readable exact-work PDF or HTML source containing the problem statements.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the article's open-problem statements was recovered.

The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, bibliographic pages, journal issue indexes, search snippets, or related pages. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/2108311.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
